title: Asynchronous capture + quiescence validation for robust multi-stream CUDA-graph replay
creator: Maya Chen
description: Reduce spurious CUDA-graph capture/replay failures in multi-tenant, multi-stream decode by introducing an asynchronous capture mode with explicit stream quiescence and a shadow-validation replay path. Current failures come from latent inter-stream kernel side-effects and nondeterministic prefill timing when multiple contexts share the same GPU. This ticket implements heuristics to ensure captures happen in a quiescent window, attaches lightweight monotonic checks to replays, and provides an opt-in validation mode that runs shadow replays to catch regressions before mainline rollout.
scope:
- Implement async capture orchestration that waits for stream quiescence markers prior to graph capture.
- Add lightweight monotonicity and KV-cache epoch checks during replay to detect divergence.
- Build a shadow-capture/validation mode for canary traffic to run replay verification without affecting production outputs.
- Expose two new runtime knobs: capture_quiesce_ms (int) and shadow_validation_rate (0..100).
- Add metrics, logs, and a console dashboard tile for capture/replay health.
background: We observe intermittent capture failures and wrong-token divergence in long-tail workloads when prefill and decode streams interleave. Existing fixes (graph segmentation, manual fences) mitigated some cases but introduced latency and complexity. The goal is to make capture timing robust without significantly increasing p50 latency or throughput cost.
proposed_solution: 1) Introduce a quiescence protocol: mark active streams, drain outstanding kernel launches, and wait capture_quiesce_ms (default 8ms) beyond the last kernel completion before issuing cudaGraphCaptureBegin. 2) Perform an async lightweight dry-run: schedule a non-blocking kernel that validates KV cache epoch and prefix checksum; if mismatch detected, abort capture and fall back to non-graph path. 3) Shadow validation: for a configurable subset of requests (shadow_validation_rate), spawn a non-critical replay of the captured graph on a spare stream/epoch and compute a compact hash of emitted token logits to verify deterministic replay; log mismatches as REDWOOD_REPLAY_DIFF. 4) Add monotonic replay checks that ensure token index progression and kv-cache epoch monotonicity. 5) Provide telemetry (capture_attempts, capture_aborts, replay_mismatches, shadow_validation_fail_rate).
design_decisions: Prefer async quiesce over global GPU-wide barriers to avoid throughput regression.
Default capture_quiesce_ms conservative (8ms) but tunable per-cluster based on empirical latency profiles.
Shadow validation runs on best-effort streams to avoid impacting production latency; failures only trigger alarms and optional automatic fallbacks.
Use compact 64-bit rolling hash of logits for fast comparison instead of full token sequence diffs.
tradeoffs: Waiting for quiescence can increase worst-case capture latency by a few ms; mitigated by short default window and heuristics to skip when low contention.
Shadow validation consumes spare capacity; in constrained clusters we degrade rate to 0 and rely on monotonic checks.
aggressive capture thresholds reduce false-positive aborts but increase risk of subtle divergence.
milestones: M1: Quiescence markers and capture delay implemented (branch: runtime/async-capture) - 2025-01-30
M2: KV-epoch lightweight dry-run and abort path - 2025-02-12
M3: Shadow validation prototype and metrics - 2025-02-26
M4: Canary rollout, dashboards, and automatic fallback tuning - 2025-03-05
progress_updates: 2025-01-22: PoC for quiescence markers completed; integrated into capture path. Initial microbench shows +1.2ms p50 for capture calls under high concurrency.
2025-02-08: KV-epoch dry-run implemented; caught 3 divergence cases in internal stress tests. Created GH PR #1247 for review.
2025-02-20: Shadow validation runs show 99.87% agreement with mainline graph on 10k sample requests; two mismatches traced to race in prefix prefill ordering.
2025-03-03: Adjusted capture_quiesce_ms from 12ms -> 8ms after profiling; updated default knobs. Preparing canary rollout plan.
2025-03-05: Docs drafted for console tile and runtime knobs; request review from Observability team.
acceptance_criteria: All captures in canary clusters must have capture_aborts <= 0.5% under baseline load.
Shadow validation false positive rate < 0.1% after one week of canary traffic.
No measurable increase in p50 token latency > 3% for workloads in canary cluster compared to baseline.
Observed replay_mismatches correlate with identified prefill races and have actionable stack traces in logs.
test_plan: Unit tests for quiescence marker lifecycle and timeout behavior.
Integration test: multi-context synthetic workload that interleaves prefill and decode streams to reproduce previous divergence patterns; assert no mismatch for 1M tokens.
Chaos test: introduce kernel launch delays and stream preemption to verify capture aborts and fallback to non-graph path.
Performance test: throughput sweep 1..32 concurrent streams to verify latency/throughput impact.
Shadow validation correctness: run 100k sampled requests and assert hash agreement rate > 99.9%
benchmarks: Internal perf run (2025-02-25): 16 concurrent streams, seq=1024 prefill+decode: baseline graph path p50=14.8ms p99=58.3ms; async-quiesce p50=15.6ms p99=61.1ms (p50 +5.4%, p99 +4.8%).
Canary simulation (2025-02-28): shadow_validation_rate=5% => observed CPU/SM idle increase ~0.8% and storage ops +0.2%.
Stress test: KV-epoch checks aborted 12 captures out of 24k attempts in high contention synthetic bench; those fell back to non-graph path with no correctness loss.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: deploy runtime binary to internal canary clusters with knobs defaulted off. (1 day).
Phase 1: enable async capture and KV-epoch checks with shadow_validation_rate=1% in non-customer canaries (3 days). Monitor capture_aborts and replay_mismatches.
Phase 2: increase shadow_validation_rate to 5% and enable in small customer-facing cluster; evaluate for 7 days.
Phase 3: if metrics stable, promote to 50% clusters and enable capture_quiesce_ms default; continue to monitor and tune.
Rollback: disable async capture and shadow_validation; revert to earlier graph capture branch. Automated runbook linked.
notes: Follow-up tickets: tune capture_quiesce_ms per GPU family (A100 vs H100), add automatic knob calibration based on observed contention, and integrate replay-diff traces with Console trace sampling. Coordinate with Scheduling team to surface spare-stream capacity for shadow validation in high-utilization clusters.
